text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Fwaaah we’re back! A-amazing, so many presents...! The reward stage was insane... why does this feel like a happy kind of exhaustion...

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume F
text_block_list.text: Yes, I rolled a “2”! Only two spaces left to the goal, one more breath...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Stoooop!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Two spaces to the goal... is what you thought? Tch tch tch. Too sweet, sweeter than peanut butter.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This is a forced stop point. If you don’t clear this, you ain’t movin’! Now wear these cute outfits prepared by Golshi-chan—

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: W-wait, are those reindeer outfits? There’s Santa too! So cute! What is this, like a fashion show??

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It’s the “Christmas Minus One GP”! Boom boom puff puff pipipipiiii!!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: C-Christmas Minus One GP!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Rules are simple! Perform a short skit related to Christmas! The theme is decided by your dice roll!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And! You gotta beat the Golshi-chan and Mame-chin combo in funniness!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: Eh, me as well!? I was not informed of this!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Of course! This doesn’t start without you! When it comes to a comedy partner, Mame-chin’s the only choice!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall preside. Dance to your heart’s content.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hmm hmm... stick-prop joke, reindeer antlers! Over there’s doing a Christmas tree impression... not bad.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, that group’s doing a short comedy skit.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: “The main dish of Christmas dinner is... tuna!” “Why tho!”... feels like seasoned timing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But! Standing before them is the Golmeno duo!! Let’s go, Mame-chiiin!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Short skit: “Shortened Shifts.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: A-alright! I’ve finished delivering presents to the good children of this house.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: Now, reindeer-kun, let us head to the next—whoaaah!? W-wait—too fast, too fast! I haven’t closed the bag yet!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Move it! We’re late, bucko!! It’s clock-out dash time!! Fuga fuga fuga!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: I-I understand, but the presents are faaaaalling!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: This speed is illegal! Absolutely illegal speed!! Stop riiiiiight now!!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!! Wait, that’s less a skit and more actually dragging him around!? Rampaging reindeer!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Eighty-eight points. All of you must surpass this to escape.

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume E
text_block_list.text: I’ll surpass it! My ultra-detailed short impressions! “Santa Claus when he finds one single black hair in his beard.”

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Me too! Let’s see... I’ll do Brian-senpai’s stoic face when she first saw Chairman Rudolph posing as a shining Christmas tree!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gwahaha! You guys got good material! Bring it onnn!!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh nooo I never thought I’d have to do a comedy skit...! I think I used up a lifetime’s worth of humor...!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Your bit was funny! By the way, what did Nakayama-san make you do? She taught me poker...!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Haah... the reward stage was incredible... I’m so full... today was amazing... really amazing...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Pheew... everyone’s reached the goal. Man, this feels like climbing up to the 7th station of Mt. Fuji.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Hehe, good work. That comedy performance was wonderful. ...Oh? Now that you mention it, where is Meno-san?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? Now that you mention it, he’s gone. Even though I told him he could do the final closing clap—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno (Stay Gold)
text_block_list.text: It’s time for the final event! We Santas bring Christmas presents to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We? Hey, weren’t you supposed to be the only Santa—
Hey, looks like it’s lively. Arriving a bit late, your Santa has come.

text_block_list.name: Golshi and Others
text_block_list.text: What—
